checklist100.note: 35 requirements in 3 groups. It only appears after the credits (Progress, Stats, 100% Completion), but everything you did during the story already counts. PowerPyx calls it roughly 60% of true completion.
checklist100.title: A Long Road — the 100% checklist

stages.detail: Chapters 1–4 and the final mission. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus.
stages.name: Play the story
stages.warning: Before leaving Chapter 1: do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house (after Down to Earth). It may be needed for Positive Mental Attitude and it disappears after Chapter 1.

stages.detail: Finish the stranger mission strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — plus three more strands, and the partner activities. Start every strand the moment its question-mark icon appears.
stages.name: Strangers & partners
stages.warning: Race Against Yago (Chapter 3) is time-sensitive — it carries an hourglass icon. Run it the day it appears.

stages.detail: Races, fishing, arcade, drone races, shooting range, stunts, challenges, robberies and the one-off stunts. Try every activity type once for Master of None.
stages.name: Activities & combat
stages.warning: Cheats switch off trophies and saving — keep them off your trophy save.

stages.detail: Meditation spots, card sets, WAiNK scans, vehicle discovery and the full map of Leonida. Scan as you travel; do not leave it all for the end.
stages.name: Collectibles & exploration
stages.warning: WAiNK 100 locations and 200 vehicles scanned are also 100% checklist items — do them together.

stages.detail: Bank vaults, fencing, garages, the shooting-range golds and the long grinds. Fund it all with the robbery money from stages 1–3.
stages.name: Money & cleanup
stages.warning: Bank vaults hand you a 4-star Wanted level — park a fast getaway car outside first.

stages.detail: Open the checklist under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion after the credits and clear its 35 requirements. A Long Road pops, then the Platinum.
stages.name: 100% & Platinum
stages.warning: The checklist is lenient — most items need only part of a set, and nothing on it is missable.

subtitle: Six stages, in order. Do them in this order and nothing is missable — except one meditation in Chapter 1.
title: Roadmap to the Platinum
